units.source_text: 二女公子看他可怜，将身稍稍靠近他些，对他说道：“说起雕像，我忽然想到一件事，只是怪不好意思告诉你。”

en.t: Taking pity on him, the Second Princess moved a little closer to him and said, "Speaking of statues, I have just thought of something, though I feel terribly embarrassed to tell you."

units.source_text: 说时态度比以前亲切了些。

en.t: As she spoke, her manner was a little warmer than before.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言喜出望外，连忙问道：“什么事呢？”

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was overjoyed beyond expectation and quickly asked, "What is it?"

units.source_text: 同时从帷屏底下伸进手去，握住了二女公子的手。

en.t: At the same time, he reached in under the screen and took the Second Princess's hand.

units.source_text: 二女公子觉得很讨厌。

en.t: The Second Princess found it deeply unpleasant.

units.source_text: 但她正想设法制止他的恋情，以便放心地和他对话。

en.t: But she was just then trying to find a way to restrain his passion, so that she could speak with him at ease.

units.source_text: 而且如果声张起来，近旁的侍女看了也不成样。

en.t: Besides, if she made a fuss, it would look improper if the waiting women nearby saw it.

units.source_text: 因此装作若无其事，对他说道：“有一个多年以来生死不明的人，今年夏天从远方来到京都，说要来访问我。

en.t: So she pretended that nothing was wrong and said to him, "There is someone whose life or death had been unknown for many years, and this summer she came to the capital from far away, saying that she wished to visit me.

units.source_text: 我想这个人和我关系不疏，然而素未谋面，要立刻和她亲热恐也不能。

en.t: I thought this person was not distantly related to me, but since we had never met, I feared I could not become intimate with her at once.

units.source_text: 前些时果然来了，一看，她的面貌和姐姐肖似得奇怪，我就立刻感到她很可亲。

en.t: A little while ago she did in fact come, and when I saw her, her face resembled my elder sister's so strangely that I immediately felt close to her.

units.source_text: 你常说我是亡姐的遗念，其实据侍女们说，我虽然和姐姐同胞，但在各方面都和姐姐大不相像。

en.t: You often say that I am a remembrance of my late sister, but according to the waiting women, although she and I were born of the same parents, I am quite unlike her in every way.

units.source_text: 这个人同姐姐关系疏远，不知怎的反而如此毕肖。”

en.t: This person is only distantly connected with my sister, and yet somehow she resembles her so completely."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听了，疑心自己是在做梦。

en.t: When Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard this, he wondered whether he was dreaming.

units.source_text: 他说：“一定是有缘分，才会如此亲密。

en.t: He said, "There must be some bond of fate for her to feel so close.

units.source_text: 但不知何以不曾听说过。”

en.t: But I wonder why I had never heard of this before."

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“唉，什么缘分，我也弄不清楚。

en.t: The Second Princess said, "Ah, what sort of bond it is, I cannot make out either.

units.source_text: 父亲在世之时，常常担心自己死后，遗下的女儿孤苦无依，身世飘零。

en.t: When Father was alive, he often worried that after his death the daughter he left behind would be lonely, helpless, and adrift in the world.

units.source_text: 只在我一人身上，他已十分担心。

en.t: Even with only me, he was already deeply worried.

units.source_text: 如果再有此种事情，外间传说开去，更将惹人耻笑了。”

en.t: If there were such a matter besides, and word of it spread outside, it would invite still more ridicule."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言从这话中察知：大约八亲王有一个私通的妇人，生下这个女儿，不知在哪里养育起来的。

en.t: From these words Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, understood that the Eighth Prince had probably had a woman in a secret affair, who had borne this daughter and raised her somewhere unknown.

units.source_text: 二女公子说她相貌酷肖大女公子，这句话攒进他耳朵里去，他就追问：“只有这几句话，使我不得要领。

en.t: The Second Princess's statement that the woman looked exactly like the Elder Princess lodged in his ears, and he pressed her further, "Those few words alone leave me unable to grasp the matter.

units.source_text: 你既然对我说了，就请详细告诉我吧。”

en.t: Since you have told me this much, please tell me the details."

units.source_text: 二女公子终觉不好意思，不肯对他详说，只是答道：“你倘要去寻访，我可把地址告诉你。

en.t: The Second Princess still felt embarrassed and would not explain it to him in detail, but only replied, "If you wish to seek her out, I can tell you where she is.

units.source_text: 至于详细情形，我也不甚明白。

en.t: As for the exact circumstances, I do not understand them very well myself.

units.source_text: 说得太详细了，只怕使你扫兴。”

en.t: If I speak too fully, I fear it may disappoint you."

units.source_text: 薰中纳言说：“为了寻访亡魂在处，即使是海上仙山，亦当全力以赴。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, said, "To seek the place where a departed soul may be, I would devote all my strength, even if it were on an immortal mountain beyond the sea.

units.source_text: 我对此人的恋慕虽未若是其甚，但与其如此魂思梦想，无法慰情，还不如前往寻访。

en.t: My longing for this person may not go quite so far, but rather than yearning in dreams and thoughts like this, unable to comfort my heart, I would rather go and seek her out.

units.source_text: 只要能胜如令姐的雕像，便供奉她为宇治山乡的本尊，有何不可？

en.t: If she surpasses the statue of your elder sister, why should I not enshrine her as the principal image of the mountain village at Uji?

units.source_text: 还请你详细指示。”

en.t: Please give me detailed directions."
